correctness.rationale: Standard graph-Hom polyhedral definition with all 24 Chvátal edges specified. Two independently constructed complete cell sets coincide (440,760,280,20) in dimensions 0–3. A 280-pair explicit valid elementary-collapse certificate is verified against the entire live face poset; the remaining graph is connected with 440 vertices and 500 edges, proving the integral 61-circle homotopy type and fundamental group. All eight graph automorphisms are exhaustively enumerated by edge and nonedge preservation. Fixed-cell oriented cellular traces and the Lefschetz identity give the D4 rational H1 character (61,1,1,-9,1), with irreducible multiplicities 6,10,5,10,15. These finite computations cover every cell and action element of this explicitly finite claim, and do not assert a universal conjecture.

value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is a canonical triangle-free four-chromatic, girth-four extremal target outside recent square-free Hom-complex classification theorems. Determining its pentagon multimorphism topology and full dihedral H1 character is a motivated boundary test: a 3-dimensional regular CW complex collapses to a free 61-generator one-dimensional space, and the nontrivial -9 reflection traces show substantial symmetry structure. Exact integral homotopy and rational representation distinguish it from merely counting graph colorings or reproducing a known graph table. The result is a precise self-contained finite homotopy classification with plausible downstream use as a benchmark and obstruction example.
